Book an Appointment Call 01332 438 900 Car tyres Derby, Ascot Drive Need new car tyres? KAM in Derby offers it all: expert advice, great selection, and quick, easy fitting. Whether you're looking for budget-friendly options or premium brands, we have the perfect car tyres to suit your needs and budget. Our knowledgeable team will guide you through our extensive selection, ensuring you find the ideal car tyres to match your driving style and vehicle type. Whether you prioritise comfort, performance, or fuel efficiency, we have the perfect car tyres for you. Our fast and efficient fitting service ensures that you'll be back on the road in no time. Our skilled technicians will quickly and expertly install your new car tyres, ensuring a safe and comfortable ride. We also offer a variety of additional services, such as wheel balancing, alignment, and puncture repair, to ensure that your car tyres are in top condition. Visit our store on Ascot Drive in Derby today or book your appointment online for a hassle-free car tyre fitting experience. Book an Appointment Call 01332 438 900 Cam belt replacement Derby, Ascot Drive Your timing belt is a critical component of your car's engine, but it's often overlooked. A worn or damaged timing belt can lead to serious engine problems, including engine failure. That's why it's important to have your timing belt inspected and replaced as needed. Our expert mechanics will conduct a thorough inspection of your timing belt, pulleys, and tensioner. We'll carefully examine the belt for signs of wear, such as fraying, cracking, or excessive stretching. We'll also inspect the pulleys and tensioner for any damage or misalignment. If we find any issues, we'll recommend the necessary repairs. If your timing belt needs to be replaced, we'll use high-quality replacement parts and ensure that it's installed correctly. We'll carefully remove the old belt and install the new one, paying close attention to the alignment and tension. Enquire Now Call 01332 438 900 DPF cleaning Derby, Ascot Drive DPF Cleaning: Breathe New Life into Your Diesel Is your diesel vehicle struggling with reduced power, increased fuel consumption, or DPF-related warning lights? Our professional DPF cleaning service can help. DPF filters are essential for capturing harmful soot particles, but over time, they can become clogged, restricting airflow and leading to decreased engine performance, higher emissions, and potentially costly repairs. Our DPF Cleaning Process: Comprehensive Inspection: We carefully assess your DPF's condition to determine the most effective cleaning method. Advanced Cleaning: Utilizing state-of-the-Art equipment and techniques, we thoroughly remove soot and contaminants from your DPF. Restored Performance: After cleaning, your DPF will operate more efficiently, improving fuel economy, reducing emissions, and restoring your vehicle's power. Book an Appointment Call 01332 438 900 Hybrid EV servicing Derby, Ascot Drive Your hybrid vehicle deserves the same care as a traditional car, with a few extra considerations. Our expert technicians will handle all the routine maintenance, including oil changes, tire rotations, and brake inspections. Beyond the basics, we'll also meticulously check your hybrid's unique components. This includes the inverter coolant, which keeps the electric motor running smoothly. We'll inspect the charging point for any issues and ensure your battery is in top condition. **Using advanced diagnostic tools, we'll assess your battery's health, voltage, and state of charge. If needed, we'll recommend maintenance or replacement to keep your hybrid running efficiently. Schedule a service today and trust our skilled technicians to care for your hybrid. We use the latest technology and follow manufacturer guidelines to provide the best care possible.
